name: rich-reversible-style-transformation-receipts
instr:
Rich cannot record, replay, or reverse the style transformations made while rendering. Add optional immutable tracing across nested renderables without changing ordinary output, and isolate consecutive and nested capture scopes and live frames.

`StyleOperation` is an Enum, `SegmentRole` is an Enum, and `StyleReceipt` and `StyleTrace` are frozen and public from `rich.style_receipt`. Receipts retain exact source and result fingerprints, changed attributes, roles, and resolved theme context. `StyleReplayError` is a ValueError, while `replay_style` and `reverse_style` are public from `rich.style_replay`. They validate the complete ordered chain before returning, atomically raising `StyleReplayError` for incomplete, reordered, source, result, or relevant-theme mismatches. Record every transformation in observed rendering and operand order, including Text spans and nested boundaries; empty rendering has an empty trace.

Expose `StyleChainResult` from `rich.style`. Traced composition keeps ordinary Style precedence and records one receipt per operand. Expose `TracedSegment` from `rich.segment`. Traced segment styling stays lazy, consumes input once, preserves text and boundaries, applies base before post style, and records controls as unstyled exemptions.

Styled, Tree, Padding, Align, Syntax, Console, and LiveRender propagate requested tracing and distinguish content, outer styles, guides, horizontal and vertical padding, and controls. Console provides `trace_styles(self, console,
